Although CarPlay supports hundreds of apps, Apple Weather is not one of them. The good news is that starting today, The Weather Channel's Storm Radar iPhone app officially supports CarPlay.

Storm Radar is one of the growing number of weather apps that support CarPlay

The Weather Channel has been working hard all year to make Storm Radar a top-tier app on the Apple platform.

The iPhone and iPad versions added AI-powered forecasting features earlier this year, followed by an Apple Watch version.

Today's new update goes even further, bringing a dedicated CarPlay app. Here is the interface of this app:

The CarPlay version of Storm Radar includes a map of your location, allowing you to switch between satellite imagery and default map backgrounds. Data layers include radar, cloud cover, and precipitation.

Navigation is also one of the core features of this CarPlay app. Storm Radar displays your current weather conditions while providing you with an estimated time of arrival (ETA) and the forecast weather at your destination.

The Weather Channel added that CarPlay support includes "automatic rerouting, and weather alerts updated along the route during your drive".

Today's update to the Storm Radar app also adds new home screen widgets, a redesigned Apple Watch app, and more features. You can check out the full release notes for version 4.0.19 on the App Store.
